name: turkish-cbi-data
title: Turkish Citizenship by Investment: Open Data
description: Machine-readable reference data on Türkiye's citizenship-by-investment programme under Law No. 5901 Art. 12(1)(b): qualifying thresholds and their legal basis, route conditions, government transaction costs, required documents, apostille status, observed processing times, the investor residence permit of Presidential Decision No. 11994, published statistics, and an index of primary sources. Every figure is dated and sourced; unpublished figures are recorded as null rather than estimated. General information about Turkish law, not legal advice.
citation: Sevimli, R. and Ra Legal (2026). Turkish Citizenship by Investment: Open Data. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24372293

sources.title: Turkish Citizenship Law No. 5901 and its implementing Regulation
Resmi Gazete (Official Gazette of the Republic of Türkiye)
Turkish Statistical Institute (TUIK) house sales statistics

resources.name: investment-thresholds
resources.title: Investment thresholds
resources.description: Current and historical qualifying investment thresholds per route, holding periods, the instrument behind each change, family inclusion rules and general requirements.

resources.name: government-costs
resources.title: Government costs
resources.description: Government and third-party transaction costs per route, as a fixed amount, a per-person amount or a percentage of value. Attorney fees are excluded.

fields.name: route
fields.description: Investment route the item applies to, or all

fields.name: basis
fields.description: How the amount is expressed: fixed, per_person or percent

fields.name: amount_usd_low
fields.description: Low end of the amount in US dollars, where a fixed amount applies

fields.name: amount_usd_high
fields.description: High end of the amount in US dollars, where a fixed amount applies

fields.name: percent_of_value
fields.description: Rate as a percentage of the transaction or investment value

fields.name: percent_of_value_high
fields.description: Upper rate where the percentage varies

resources.name: document-checklist
resources.title: Document checklist
resources.description: Documents required of the main applicant, a spouse and children, with apostille or legalisation status.

resources.name: apostille-countries
resources.title: Apostille countries
resources.description: Hague Apostille Convention status for every Contracting Party, with the date the Convention entered into force for each, by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

resources.name: processing-times
resources.title: Processing times
resources.description: Observed duration per stage of an application and the end-to-end range. Marked basis=observed: no Turkish authority publishes an official figure.

resources.name: investment-returns
resources.title: Investment returns
resources.description: Year-end index levels and rates for the qualifying asset classes, with USD/TRY. Gross of taxes and fees; not investment advice.

resources.name: investor-residence-permit
resources.title: Investor residence permit
resources.description: The investor residence permit created by Presidential Decision No. 11994 (Resmi Gazete 18 November 2026, No. 33434). A residence track, not a citizenship route.

resources.name: statistics
resources.title: Statistics
resources.description: Long-format statistical observations on citizenship acquisitions, the investment route, foreign property purchases and 2026 enforcement action. Each record names its source and as-of date; value is null where not published.

resources.name: sources
resources.title: Sources
resources.description: Register of the statutes, regulations, decisions, circulars and statistical publications behind every figure, with Resmi Gazete dates and a verification status per citation.
